name: rundrill-secure-coding
description: Secure-coding coach (OWASP) — learn to find, exploit, and fix the vulnerabilities that ship in real code: injection, XSS, broken auth and access control, weak crypto, SSRF, deserialization, supply-chain and AI risks. You practise by reviewing AI-written code for security bugs, patching vulnerable code, and threat-modeling designs — the coach never writes the fix for you — with drills, progress, and mistake memory inside your AI agent.
